tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Platform Architect & Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java & APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and digital commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and API integrations. Proven expertise in solution architecture, technical design, scalability, and working closely with business and technical stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong English communication skills.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Senior/Architect)
cover_en.hook: KCS iT’s commitment to transparency, flexibility, and building diverse digital solutions makes this Salesforce Commerce Cloud Architect opportunity an exciting fit. With over 5 years of professional experience designing, building, and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in digital commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Solution Architecture & Design
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend solutions on enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java and Spring, establishing scalable, secure, and maintainable technical architectures for global channels.

bullets.label: APIs & Integration
bullets.text: Engineered and exposed RESTful APIs, headless web services, and data pipelines integrating PIM, ERP, and MDM systems to ensure seamless data flow across enterprise platforms.

bullets.label: Stakeholder & Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Partnered directly with international business and technical stakeholders to analyse requirements, define functional specifications, provide technical guidance, and support development teams.

bullets.label: DevOps & Release Management
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and automated testing suites within agile environments to maintain high platform stability and code quality.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Germany with a valid residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise e-commerce architecture experience aligns with KCS iT.

tailoring.why_company: KCS iT stands out for its strong core values of integrity, transparency, flexibility, and teamwork, while offering engaging international challenges and a commitment to employee well-being. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture and integration experience to KCS iT to help drive scalable, high-performing digital commerce solutions for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: To leverage my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce architecture, API integration, and stakeholder collaboration experience to build scalable digital solutions at KCS iT.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years designing enterprise e-commerce platforms, APIs, and integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Architect role at KCS iT. My CV and cover letter are attached. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Senior/Architect) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Salesforce Commerce Cloud Architect position at KCS iT. With over 5 years of professional experience designing, building, and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms, APIs, and integrations for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise and strong stakeholder collaboration skills.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
